name: sig_reserved_param
sed: s/^signature fn ndigits n ulong/signature fn ndigits end ulong/

name: sig_no_to
sed: s/^signature fn ndigits n ulong to uchar$/signature fn ndigits n ulong uchar/

name: sig_bad_type
sed: s/^signature fn ndigits n ulong to/signature fn ndigits n ulongx to/

name: sig_void_abs
sed: s/^ret u8$/ret void/;s/^signature fn ndigits n ulong to uchar$/signature fn ndigits n ulong to void/

name: abs_two_fn
sed: /^k = uchar 1$/i fn other a uint to uint

name: body_sig_mismatch
sed: s/^fn ndigits n ulong to uchar$/fn ndigits m ulong to uchar/
